moat_against: Measured returns contradict a wide moat: ROIC proxy 24.5% (FY2017) to 2.2% (FY2026) and operating margin 17.4% to 7.2% in the last two fiscal years alone (fundamentals.json)
Commodity, price-compared purchase: customers rent on price and proximity with zero switching cost; Penske, Avis Budget and Enterprise contest every market
Capital intensity: fleet and storage capex ($3,154,325k in FY2026, 10-K cash-flow statement) runs at roughly 2.7x depreciation — the network must be continuously re-bought

Post-COVID over-expansion: FY2026 fleet depreciation rose $186.6M and disposal losses were $117.6M (FY2026 results release); management says new storage units are still completing faster than they fill (Q1 FY2027 release)

Shoen-family control and a related-party web ($114.1M of related-party costs in FY2026, 10-K) plus leverage — notes, loans and finance leases payable of $8,083,374k against $1,120,147k of cash at March 31, 2026 — limit minority-holder recourse and flexibility
moat_for: Location density no rival matches: 24,000+ rental locations (company stores + independent dealers) vs roughly 2,500 for Penske — convenience is the purchase criterion in DIY moving
Scale: a fleet of approximately 207,600 trucks, larger than the top three competitors combined, and over 50% share of the DIY self-moving market
Brand default since 1945 — U-Haul is the generic name for a rental truck, feeding direct and app demand (Truck Share 24/7 self-dispatch)
Self-storage flywheel: #3 operator in North America (about 100.3M sq ft) attached to the moving funnel; storage revenue +8.3% in FY2026 with revenue per occupied foot rising
Dealer network expands reach on other people's capital; vertical integration (fleet manufacturing/repair, propane retail, hitch installation) supports availability and cost
moat_justification: Dominant DIY moving network — 24,000+ locations, >50% DIY share, a fleet larger than the top three rivals combined and the #3 self-storage operator in North America — but a capital-intensive, price-compared rental business whose measured returns have eroded: the ROIC proxy fell from 24.5% (FY2017) to 2.2% (FY2026) and operating margin from 21.7% to 7.2% over the same span (fundamentals.json), so the network moat is real but is no longer earning wide-moat returns.
name: U-Haul Holding Company
one_liner: Dominant moving-and-storage network, moat 5/10, but no positive conservative owner's earnings at any point in the last 5 years — fleet capex swallows operating cash flow (base OE -$7.85/share, latest FY -$6.93/share), so Tier F at $57.02; it clears no hurdle on this model and even the maintenance definition (FY2026 OE $83,128k) is under 1% of the $11.18B market cap.

sbc_override.ack_reason: Out-of-band by construction: the engine has no filed SBC value to band against (last filed value is null under every SBC tag in every year), so any value flags out-of-band. The $0 is not an estimate — it is proven by the filer's own FY2026 10-K cash-flow statement, which enumerates every operating reconciliation item for FY2024-FY2026 and reconciles exactly to reported operating cash flow with no SBC line.
sbc_override.reason: DATA_GAP:sbc — SBC missing for FY2024, FY2025, FY2026 under every engine tag because the filer recognizes no equity-settled share-based compensation in those years: there is no SBC expense inside or outside operating cash flow to subtract, so the filing-proven value is $0. The ESOP holds already-outstanding shares (686,697 voting shares per the 10-K) and the 2016 shelf stock option plan produced no expense, issuance or share-count change in the period.
sbc_override.source: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 (filed 2026-05-27, accession 0001193125-26-241850), Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows (p. F-6): the operating-activities reconciliation for FY2026, FY2025 and FY2024 is enumerated in full (depreciation $1,183,133k / $971,933k / $817,889k, premium amortization, debt-issuance amortization, interest credited to policyholders, disposal gains/losses, deferred taxes and working-capital changes) with no share-based or stock-based compensation line anywhere in it, and the listed items reconcile exactly to the reported operating cash flow ($1,794,584k / $1,454,429k / $1,452,756k) with no SBC addback. The terms 'share-based' and 'stock-based' appear nowhere in the filing, EDGAR companyfacts carries no ShareBasedCompensation or AllocatedShareBasedCompensationExpense fact for CIK 4457 in any year, and weighted average shares were flat at 196,077,880 combined throughout FY2024-FY2026.

shares_override.reason: DATA_GAP:shares — DILUTED shares missing for FY2024, FY2025, FY2026 in companyfacts because the filer tags only WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesOutstandingBasic (at the combined 196,077,880); its own EPS note states that this combined count IS the basic and diluted denominator for both share classes, so the filing-sourced diluted count is 196,077,880. The override changes no per-share figure (the engine already used this count as the fallback); it certifies it as the diluted count the filing itself reports.
shares_override.source: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 (filed 2026-05-27, accession 0001193125-26-241850), Note 4 Earnings Per Share (pp. F-17/F-18) and the Consolidated Statements of Operations: weighted average shares outstanding are stated on a 'Basic and diluted' basis for both classes — Voting Common Stock 19,607,788 plus Series N Non-Voting Common Stock 176,470,092 equals a total of 196,077,880 — with the identical total for FY2026, FY2025 and FY2024; EPS is computed under the two-class method with basic and diluted the same.
